_comment: 56 NATIONAL SERIES — Vol.9 of the Urban Social Series. November 2026.
Single source of truth for the season's numbers: the app, the brand art and
the signup posts all read this file so none of them can advertise a figure
the others contradict. Same discipline as blackout-season.json.
SCHEDULE. Mondays and Wednesdays through November 2026 — nine nights, which
is every Mon/Wed the month has. The owner's call on 31 Oct 2026: no Friday
night, and National Day is marked on WED 18 NOVEMBER, which is the real
one. The design handoff put a National Day night on Fri 20 Nov; that is not
what we are running.
PRIZE POOL. 14 x 2 players x 9 nights = 252, plus 160 of season prizes, is
412 — the same budget Vol.8 paid out. Derived from these parts rather than
typed, so changing a part here is the only way to move it.
DOUBLE NIGHTS ARE A LIST, NOT A THRESHOLD. Vol.8 used doubleFromSession:
every night from the 8th onward counted double. That cannot express 'the
National Day night is double' when the night after it is not. The engine
already reads a per-session doublePoints flag, so a list is what the app
actually honours; doubleFromSession stays only for Vol.8's own copy.
ASSUMPTION TO CONFIRM: three double nights — National Day (S6) plus the
last two (S8, S9), which is Vol.8's 'last two' rule with the National Day
night added because the design puts a 2X badge on it. Drop S6 or the last
two if that is one too many; nothing but the points moves either way, since
vouchers are per night won regardless.
name: 56 NATIONAL SERIES
_paletteNotes: Straight from the handoff's token list. The jobs are not interchangeable:
bg        the red base, everywhere, under the khanjar tile at 14%
deep      rows and bands that sit ON the base and must still read
flag      live states and accents — the loud red
ivory     hero cards and anything that has to carry dark type
ink       text, CTAs and the tab bar
muted     secondary text ON IVORY only
green     NATIONAL DAY ONLY. It is the flag's green and it means the
18th. Use it anywhere else and it stops meaning anything.
inactive  tab text that is not the current tab
ink on ivory is the readable pair; rose on bg is the label pair. There is
no dark-on-red combination that clears 4.5:1, so type on the base is white
_shapeNotes: NO SQUARE BLOCKS. Hero cards are arches, everything else is a pill, icons
sit in circles. This is the whole difference between this volume and
Blackout, which was radius 0 everywhere — so a component carried over
unchanged reads as Vol.8 no matter what colour it is wearing.
There are NO DROP SHADOWS. Depth is the double-line ring only.
_landmarkNotes: PLACEHOLDER ARTWORK AND AN UNCONFIRMED MAPPING. The handoff says both in
as many words: the silhouettes are placeholder vector drawings to be
replaced with commissioned artwork in the same slots, and the
landmark-per-session assignment is the product owner's to confirm.
Nothing is assigned to a session here until it is.
RULE FROM THE HANDOFF: no mosques in any landmark artwork.
_serverNotes: PORT 3011, NOT 3010. The obvious next number after Vol.8's 3009 is taken:
the chisel process that carries the SSH-over-HTTPS tunnel binds 127.0.0.1
:3010 on the VPS. It is not a club service, but it is listening and it can
re-bind, and an API that loses its port at a restart fails in the middle of
a night rather than at deploy time.
